sources.observed: MLX-LM documents inference and low-rank/full fine-tuning on Apple silicon. Moving main documentation is not a pinned local environment.
Local JSONL training uses train.jsonl; validation file optional upstream. Supported schema does not check Engineering Library owner approval or family exclusion.
get_peak_memory reports peak used bytes since program start or the last reset. It is a measurement API, not an estimate of this unexecuted pilot.
LoRA freezes base weights and trains low-rank matrices; this does not create an independent factual verifier.

scope: Public primary documentation only; no private information in web queries. No packages or weights downloaded.
